outcome: A single policy-configured dataset freshness check reports a fresh, stale or unknown status per dataset and is consumed by the hotfire pre-review gate, the NCR SLA report grouped by owner team, and shared engineer tooling.

criteria.description: Run the pre-review freshness gate for engine_test_runs with a 60-minute threshold in three fixtures: data last loaded 59 minutes ago must report 'fresh'; data last loaded 61 minutes ago must report 'stale'; data last loaded 3 days ago (the incident case) must report 'stale' and the gate output must display that stale status visibly rather than showing the data silently. A dataset with no measurement must report 'unknown' and must not pass. Passing means all four fixtures give exactly the stated status.

Generate the freshness SLA report over a fixture set of NCR tables owned by at least two teams, including one table that has never been measured. Passing means: (1) every row is grouped under its owner team; (2) every NCR table in the fixture appears exactly once; (3) the never-measured table shows the exact status 'unknown' and not 'fresh'; (4) fresh and stale tables show 'fresh' and 'stale' correctly against their configured thresholds.

With the freshness code unchanged, edit only the policy configuration file: change a dataset threshold from 60 to 120 minutes and confirm a dataset aged 90 minutes changes from 'stale' to 'fresh'; add a new dataset entry and confirm it is checked. Then confirm by search that no dataset threshold value is hard-coded in the check's source, and that the same check is invoked from both the gate and the report with no second implementation. Passing means all of these hold with zero code changes.

Validate every per-dataset record emitted by the freshness check, in the gate, the report and the library, against one versioned interface schema pinned by producer and consumers. Passing means 100% of records validate, each record carries dataset, status, threshold and measured_at fields (measured_at null when never measured), status is only one of 'fresh', 'stale' or 'unknown', and a record with no measurement has status 'unknown'. A record with any other status value or a missing required field must fail validation.

needs_map.need: Know when the engine_test_runs dataset is stale, using a 60-minute threshold, before every hotfire review, so the dashboard does not silently show old test data.
A weekly ops-review SLA report on the freshness of the NCR tables, grouped by owner team, where a dataset that has never been measured is reported as 'unknown' and not as fresh.
One shared, reusable freshness capability to replace three hand-rolled per-engineer checks with differing thresholds, where thresholds are policy configuration rather than code.

deferred_needs.stakeholder: requester of syn-req-002 (BOM cost dashboard; stakeholder id not given in the overlap report)
deferred_needs.reason: Schema-contract drift by field is a different capability from age-against-threshold freshness, and the overlap report excludes it from the shared freshness capability. Whether to fold it in or build it as a sibling is an open decision. The pre-assigned id AC-SCHEMA-SUPPLY is reserved for it once that decision is made.
